% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): inline tables, one with a header
% and named columns, one comma-separated by column index.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}
\addplot table[x=t, y=v] {
t   u   v
0   5   1
1   4   3
2   3   2
3   2   5
};
\addplot table[col sep=comma, x index=1, y index=0] {
2,0.5
4,1.5
1,2.5
};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
